name: xr-guild-social-signal
description: A local corpus of captured web-search snippets on XR/VR community signal, gathered for XR Guild content research.

coverage.digg.com: no-useful-results; on-domain results returned but none on topic
coverage.reddit.com: blocked; refuses this host's search user agent with HTTP 400

limits: Every snippet is discovery-grade. A snippet identifies a source; it does not prove the source's contents.
No page in this corpus was opened. Nothing here can support a claim marked verified.
Single-platform sample. x.com is the only platform that produced on-domain results, so this corpus is not representative of XR conversation overall.
Off-domain results returned despite a domain filter were discarded, not recorded as platform signal.
Vendor and platform accounts are promotional sources; their claims are company-reported.
Snippets are point-in-time. Re-run the sweeps rather than treating this file as current.

sweeps.topic: XR in education and the educator audience
First-time headset reactions and demo experiences
In-person XR/VR meetup and demo-night communities
XR platform direction and developer-community signal
